title: Defect tasks carry a root-cause class and krn ledger counts repeats per class
body:
Source: Fable history review .krn/runs/arch-review/history.md.
Evidence: 35% of first-parent commits in 21 days were fixes, and 65 of 84 sampled fixes had a lower test layer that would have caught them. `krn ledger --reverts` shows 0 reverts in 400 PRs and nothing calls it, because defects are fixed forward. The 202 defect task records carry no root-cause class, so repeats are invisible. The top classes are receiver coupling (13), lane lifecycle (10), output and exit contracts (10) and narrow heuristics (9).
Files: src/task/ (schema), src/ledger*, krn ledger
Outcome: defect tasks carry a root-cause class from a fixed list. `krn ledger --classes` counts fixes per class over a window. A class that reaches 3 fixes in 14 days opens a task to build that class's mechanical check, as listed in the report.
Proof: a ledger test counts classes from fixtures; the task schema rejects a defect record with no class.
